clips.title: The story
paras: In Shadowfang Keep, Deathstalkers Adamant and Vincent have gone missing. High Executor Hadrec sends Horde adventurers inside to find the reconnaissance agents. Their intelligence is needed to prepare a Forsaken assault against Archmage Arugal and his worgen packs.

Silverpine Forest remains contested, and Archmage Arugal's worgen hold Shadowfang Keep. The Forsaken at the Sepulcher seek to break his siege on their southern borders. High Executor Hadrec sent Deathstalkers Adamant and Vincent into the fortress to chart its defenses. Days pass without word, and Hadrec grows desperate for their reports. He sends Horde champions into the stronghold to recover the agents and salvage the operation.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: In preparation for an assault on Shadowfang, two deathstalkers were sent to the keep to gather intelligence. It has been many days and they have not returned, but we must receive their report if we're to have any hope of a successful attack!
So here is your task, friend. Go to Shadowfang Keep to the south and find the Deathstalkers Adamant and Vincent. Find them, and if they require aid then give it.
This mission is as dangerous as is it critical, friend. Do not fail.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Vincent's body lies broken, and still.
Although Deathstalker Adamant will send his report to Hadrec... Whatever additional details Vincent gained must remain with him.
But clutched in his hand is a small trinket...
